notes: Reached via Claude-in-Chrome only (own tab, no curl/WebFetch). robots.txt already cleared for ClaudeBot by the prior Home-Decor pass (Allow: / plus a narrow facet-URL disallow that does not affect this extraction); re-verified the site is normally reachable in-browser. Lumens is primarily a lighting retailer but carries a full secondary Furniture department confirmed via the site's own mega-nav (data-nav-category='Furniture' plus a separate data-nav-category='Outdoor' branch that mixes outdoor lighting and outdoor furniture) and each room hub page's own facet-chip strip. TAXONOMY SOURCE: (1) the SSR mega-nav's data-nav-category/subcategory/label attributes, extracted via same-origin javascript_tool DOM reads, gave Living Room / Dining Room / Bedroom / Office / Bathroom under 'Furniture' and Outdoor Living / Outdoor Dining under 'Outdoor'; (2) each room hub page (e.g. /living-room-furniture/, /dining-room-and-kitchen-furniture/, /bedroom-furniture/, /office-furniture/) was also opened directly because the mega-nav under-reported the tree in four cases (Living Room was missing 'Benches'; Dining Room's combined 'Shelving & Storage' nav link was actually two separate hub facets 'Storage' and 'Shelving' with their own URLs; Bedroom was missing 'Armoires'; Office's combined shelving/storage nav link was actually two hub facets 'Bookcases & Shelves' and 'Office Storage Cabinets') - the hub page's own facet-chip strip was taken as authoritative over the flat mega-nav list in each such case, per the project rule to union nav + hub-page chips. (3) Entryway & Foyer Furniture and Game Room Furniture exist only as top-level cards on the /furniture/ hub page (absent from the mega-nav 'Furniture' branch entirely) and were reached and expanded directly. Their own facet chips gave Tables/Benches (Entryway) and Game Tables/Bean Bag Chairs (Game Room). 'Game Tables' under Game Room Furniture is the identical node/URL (/game-tables/) already recorded once under Living Room Furniture per the mega-nav - kept once (under Living Room) to avoid a duplicate row; the cross-listing is noted here. 'Sofas & Sectionals' and 'Accent & Lounge Chairs' also appear as shortcut cards on the top /furniture/ page but are the same nodes as Living Room's children - not duplicated. QTY: the rendered listing-page header 'N Results' is SSR'd directly into each category page's HTML on this platform (Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Constructor.io) - confirmed by pulling the raw HTML via same-origin fetch() from the loaded lumens.com origin (so cookies/session apply) and regex-matching the same figure a human would see rendered. This exact mechanism was exhaustion-tested 10 times across 5-8,675 items and found exact in the prior Home-Decor pass on this same site/platform, so it was trusted here without re-running a fresh exhaustion check (repeat verification of an already-established site-specific fact is disallowed by the efficiency rules). All qty figures varied sensibly by category (no repeated site-wide constant, no suspiciously round numbers, all far below any obvious display cap), so no flags were raised. EXCLUDED: all Lighting nodes; all Decor nodes (Rugs, Mirrors, Wall Art, Clocks, Pillows & Throws, Vases & Bowls, Decorative Objects, Tabletop & Kitchen tableware, Bath accessories/hardware/mirrors/towels, Storage-department items - Coat Racks, Umbrella Stands, Wall Hooks & Racks, Desk & Office Accessories - all standalone organisers, not furniture); Outdoor Accessories (Planters, Firepits, Umbrellas & Stands, Outdoor Rugs & Doormats, Outdoor Pillows & Throws, Electric Patio Heaters, Doorbells & House Numbers); the 'Shop By > Rooms' cross-cut hub pages (Bathroom/Bedroom/Dining Room/Entryway & Foyer/Kitchen/Home Office/Living Room/Outdoor & Patio), which are whole-room re-cuts mixing lighting+decor+furniture and would only duplicate the type-specific furniture rows already captured; Style/Curations shop-by pages (marketing collections). Bathroom Furniture's own hub page (157 results) shows no facet-chip strip beyond the two mega-nav children (Bathroom Vanities, Medicine Cabinets); the listing itself mixes in bath stools/wash-stands with no distinct addressable category URL of their own, so only the two declared nodes were recorded and the hub total was not used as a row (grouping row, qty null). Outdoor Game Tables' own hub page revealed a deeper facet split (Ping Pong/Pool/Foosball Tables, Parts & Accessories) but at 34 total items this was not further expanded, consistent with 'never pad' guidance.
